activities.title: Weight Merging Mathematics and Zero-Latency Inference Deployment

source_resources.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
source_resources.author: Edward J. Hu, Yelong Shen, Phillip Wallis, Zeyuan Allen-Zhu, Yuanzhi Li, Shean Wang, Lu Wang, Weizhu Chen
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful academic reference under arXiv open access terms.
source_resources.prerequisites: Matrix factorization, rank, linear layers, and transformer attention.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Primary literature introducing Low-Rank Adaptation, establishing parameter decomposition W = W0 + (alpha/r)*BA, initialization strategies, and zero inference latency merging.
source_resources.safe_fallback: Complete matrix derivations, tensor dimensions, and pure PyTorch LoRALinear modules are implemented directly in lesson code.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Houlsby et al. Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning for NLP (Series Adapters)
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Introduces bottleneck adapter layers in series, which introduces unavoidable inference latency overhead; LoRA's parallel formulation merges with zero latency.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Li & Liang: Prefix-Tuning: Optimizing Continuous Prompts for Generation
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Prepends virtual prompt tokens; reduces available context length, unlike LoRA which preserves full sequence capacity.

source_resources.relevant_timestamp: Section 4.1, paragraph 'No Additional Inference Latency' (store W = W0 + BA)

source_resources.title: PEFT: State-of-the-art Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning Methods
source_resources.author: Sourab Mangrulkar, Sylvain Gugger, Lysandre Debut, Younes Belkada, Sayak Paul, Benjamin Bossan
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful external reference under Apache-2.0 open-source terms.
source_resources.prerequisites: PyTorch nn.Module, Hugging Face transformers, and LoRA equations.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Widely adopted open-source library implementing LoRA configuration classes (LoraConfig), get_peft_model, and adapter serialization.
source_resources.safe_fallback: Standalone, zero-dependency PyTorch implementations of LoRALinear layers and save/reload logic are provided in curriculum scripts.

compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Original reference code by Hu et al.; PEFT expands this to broader multi-model ecosystem integration.
High-performance clean implementation; compared alongside PEFT for modular code architecture.
